equation_summary: Per chunk, build a strictly-lower Householder/delta transform: w_beta = w * beta; T_mat = I + inv(I + tril(w_beta w^T,-1)) - I (computed by forward substitution on -(w_beta@w^T) strictly lower); transformed operands A_local = tril(q k^T) - tril(q w^T) @ (T_mat @ tril(w_beta k^T)), q' = q - tril(q w^T) @ (T_mat w_beta), k' = k - (T_mat w_beta k^T)^T w; cross-chunk scores A_ij = q'_i k'_j^T with progressive q' correction q' -= q' H_j. Final logits = (A + gc_i - gc_j) * scale, softmax, @v. The typed causal triangular (UT-transform) operand correction precedes an otherwise-standard softmax attention.
state_shape: external KV cache; decode uses rank-one-updated k cache (k -= beta*(k.w)w) and w conv state
gate_scope: data-dependent per-head cumulative gate g plus per-token beta
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM E[QKV,w/beta/g,short convolution] ; B[typed causal triangular transform] ; U1.S(transformed operands) ; E[output] matches naive_path_attn: short conv + l2-norm on w are external layer ops; the triangular T_mat/UT transform produces corrected operands; the final reduction is softmax attention with cumulative-gate bias.

CONFIRM the blocker: the triangular operator needs its VJP/traffic proof and 'no projection-only equivalence' is correct — the transform is a data-dependent strictly-causal triangular solve, not a per-token projection.

MISSING-BLOCKER: the final score also adds a FoX-style cumulative log-gate bias (A + gc_i - gc_j, naive.py line 94); this reuses the arch-008 score-modulation axis and should be recorded as a dependency, not silently folded into U1.S.
axis: typed causal triangular transform (UT/Householder operand correction); also depends on A13 cumulative-log-gate score bias (arch-008)
direction_justification: The mixer needs a closed typed causal triangular transform of the operands before U1.S — a reusable typed property shared with DeltaFormer's correction family — so it is an axis, not an external ordinary op.
open_questions: Whether the triangular transform is admitted as its own descriptor or decomposed into primitive typed ops; the decode path's rank-one k-cache update must be proven equal to the parallel transform.
